sources.title: GitHub - Volemby/aiBrain: aibrain scans your repository and generates a ...
sources.snippet: aibrain is a local-first CLI tool that scans your git repository, extracts structure, conventions, and constraints, and generates a versioned Repo Brain. This brain serves as a "machine truth" for your codebase, enabling both humans and AI agents to understand and work with your project more effectively.
